overview.description: The Volatility Shares 2x Chainlink ETF (CHNU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long link, short usd currency. The fund offers 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of Chainlink (LINK), using near-term futures and LINK-related instruments. LINK is the native token of the Chanlink network CHNU was launched on Apr 1, 2026 and is issued by Volatility Shares.
